cmd.app.report.desc: Describes what went wrong and saves a bundle on this computer: your text, build and system facts, a window picture and the last crash record. Nothing is sent.
report.title: Report a problem
report.opt.shot: Include a picture of the window
report.opt.model: Include a copy of the model
report.opt.model.note: Off by default. The copy holds your project data, without the AI journal.
report.opt.paths: Keep user names in file paths
report.local: The bundle is saved on this computer only. Nothing is sent automatically.
report.failed: The bundle could not be saved: {err}
report.model.fail: The model copy could not be made, nothing was saved: {err}
report.crash.notice: The previous session ended with a crash.
